title: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals Refinances Existing Credit Facility, Lowering Borrowing Costs and Extending Maturity
summary: - Existing $400 million facility prepaid at a $68 million discount to the contractual minimum repayment amount - New $400 million term loan priced at SOFR plus 5.50% - Debt has no scheduled amortization payments or required sweeps during the term prior to the Maturity Date of November 2, 2031
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://ir.arrowheadpharma.com/node/21456/pdf)


- Existing $400 million facility prepaid at a $68 million discount to the contractual minimum repayment amount


- New $400 million term loan priced at SOFR plus 5.50%


- Debt has no scheduled amortization payments or required sweeps during the term prior to the Maturity Date of November 2, 2031


PASADENA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Nov. 4, 2026--[Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Farrowheadpharma.com%2Fen-us&esheet=54634777&newsitemid=20261104639267&lan=en-US&anchor=Arrowhead+Pharmaceuticals%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=401ce6e2fd80d927ec6db47519e9b212) (NASDAQ: ARWR) today announced that it has completed a refinancing with funds managed by Sixth Street that lowers its borrowing costs, improves near-term liquidity, extends its debt maturity, and increases financial and operational flexibility. The transaction retires Arrowhead’s existing $400 million Sixth Street facility at a $68 million discount to the contractual minimum repayment amount and establishes a new $400 million Sixth Street senior secured term loan facility bearing interest at the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) plus 5.50%.


“This transaction is an important step in aligning our capital structure with the company Arrowhead has become. By reducing the amount required to retire our existing facility and lowering our ongoing borrowing costs, we are improving the economics of our financing for shareholders,” said Daniel Apel, Chief Financial Officer of Arrowhead. “As we build the REDEMPLO® business and advance our pipeline, we are securing financing terms that more closely reflect our profile as a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company. Sixth Street’s continued support reflects its confidence in our business and the opportunities ahead.”


**Transaction Highlights**


- **Lower borrowing costs.** The new facility carries an interest rate of SOFR plus 5.50%, compared to an annual rate of 15% in the retired facility.
- **Reduced minimum prepayment multiple.** Negotiated a $68 million discount on the contractual prepayment amount on the retired facility, which originally carried a minimum 2x multiple on invested capital (MOIC) if paid in full by August 2028 and escalated to a 2.5x MOIC thereafter.
- **Reduced contractual sweep obligation.** The retired facility required Arrowhead to partially repay loans under the credit facility with a sweep of a portion of the proceeds from certain transactions, such as the future collection of upfront payments, milestones, and royalties from partnerships and collaborations, and commercial revenue by Arrowhead. The new facility eliminates these required prepayments or sweeps and reduces the prepayment premiums associated with paying off the facility early.
- **Greater strategic, financial, and operational flexibility.** The new facility significantly improves Arrowhead’s ability to independently engage in strategic, financial, and operational activities.
- **Extended maturity enhancing near-term liquidity.** The new facility matures in November 2031.


“Arrowhead has made significant progress in translating its RNAi platform into a commercial business with substantial growth opportunities,” said Jeff Pootoolal, Partner, and Michael Reslinski, Managing Director at Sixth Street. “We are pleased to continue our relationship through a new financing structure that recognizes that progress and supports the company’s next phase of growth.”


The new senior secured credit facility matures on November 2, 2031, and bears interest at an annual rate equal to the 3-month SOFR plus 5.50%, with certain additional fees and prepayment terms. There are no scheduled amortization payments during the term of the facility, with all principal due on the maturity date. Arrowhead is not required to prepay or sweep any proceeds from certain transactions, such as the future collection of upfront payments, milestones, and royalties from partnerships and collaborations, and commercial revenue. Arrowhead may prepay all or any portion of the loans at any time at a prespecified premium, not to exceed 2%, if prepaid more than 18 months after the Closing Date, plus a make-whole premium for any prepayments made prior to May 2, 2028. All obligations will be secured on a first-priority basis, subject to certain exceptions, by security interests in substantially all assets of the company. Please refer to Arrowhead’s 8-K for more information.


**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: ARWR) is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company developing medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them, harnessing the natural RNA interference (RNAi) mechanism. The company has built a broad portfolio of clinical and commercial RNAi therapeutics through its industry-leading targeted RNAi molecule (TRiM™) platform, which can precisely silence genes in a wide range of cell types, including liver, lung, muscle, adipose, and central nervous system tissue. At Arrowhead, we rapidly advance potential best- and first-in-class RNAi treatments for diseases with significant unmet medical need, because every day matters to the patients we serve.
